title: ChatArea: debounce cancel + draft send race fix
description: Fix debounce race condition on send: add cancel() to makeDebounce, call debouncedPersist.cancel() + unconditional clearDraft() on send to prevent sent messages reappearing as drafts.
action: Add cancel() method to makeDebounce return object. In ChatArea send handler, call debouncedPersist.cancel() before clearDraft(). Remove the if (persistedText) guard on clearDraft() to make it unconditional on send.

criteria: src/components/ChatArea.tsx makeDebounce function returns an object with a cancel method
src/components/ChatArea.tsx send handler calls '.cancel()' before clearDraft()
src/components/ChatArea.tsx contains 'clearDraft()' at the send handler location (unconditional)
convergence.verification: grep each criterion; run npm test
convergence.definition_of_done: Draft debounce cancel works, sent messages never reappear as drafts, tests pass

files.change: Add cancel() to makeDebounce; cancel debounce + unconditional clearDraft() on send

implementation: Modify makeDebounce (~line 117) to return an object with the debounced function AND a cancel method. Pattern: let timer; const debounced = (...args) => { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), delay); }; return { call: debounced, cancel: () => clearTimeout(timer) };

Update debouncedPersist usage (~line 138): const debouncedPersist = useMemo(() => makeDebounce(persist, 350), [persist]); then change call sites from debouncedPersist(text) to debouncedPersist.call(text)

In the send handler (~line 774): replace 'if (persistedText) clearDraft()' with 'debouncedPersist.cancel(); clearDraft()'. This ensures: (a) pending debounce timer is cancelled, (b) draft is always cleared on send regardless of persistedText state.

rationale.chosen_approach: Add cancel to existing inline makeDebounce rather than importing lodash.debounce
rationale.tradeoffs: Slightly more complex makeDebounce vs adding a dependency
